facts.activity_file: monitoring dust, fume and gas exposure

control_failures.control_label: controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents
selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: corrective action - critical safeguard at TK-8310

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control REAGENT_HANDLING_CONTROL: the controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control RESPIRATORY_PROTECTION_PROGRAM: the selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents on TK-8310 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling airborne contaminants, specifically monitoring dust, fume and gas exposure. TK-8310 (reagent storage tanks) is in service for bulk reagent storage. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 29 April 2010 a corrective action on TK-8310 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station was reviewed against the critical safeguard it was raised to restore.
